{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, verify that all revenue values are strings with commas
print("Unique revenue values:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))

# Show the first few rows with the new column
print("First 5 rows with parsed revenue:")
print(df[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_float', 'converted']].head())"}
